describes: packages/plugin/actions: the open sequence, the page-state coordinator, document events, verbs and print.

cases.name: auto-fires-on-adapter-install
cases.covers: Pre-open reports are buffered and coalesced; an adapter install runs the openDestination goto, then OpenAction, then the page open the latest report asks for; another adapter never replays it.

cases.name: auto-fires-ahead-of-the-first-user-dispatch
cases.covers: The first user-origin dispatch arms the sequence before taking its own queue slot.

cases.name: open-sequence-completed-event
cases.covers: onOpenSequenceCompleted fires once with the folded sequence result after the document steps; a throwing listener is reported to the host sink and never stops its siblings.

cases.name: auto-a-submit-handler-does-not-arm
cases.covers: Installing a submit handler is not the latch release: nothing runs until an adapter arrives.

cases.name: headless-falls-back-to-the-first-page
cases.covers: headless fires at bring-up; with no stage report the initial page open is the first page.

cases.name: headless-with-a-report
cases.covers: headless with a buffered report opens the reported page instead of the first.

cases.name: headless-with-no-pages
cases.covers: headless on a document with no pages releases the barrier and opens nothing.

cases.name: off-releases-the-barrier
cases.covers: off never runs the sequence but a report emits straight away.

cases.name: a-replayed-open-trigger
cases.covers: A document-open trigger after the sequence fired reports open-sequence-replayed; before it fired, it runs the sequence.

cases.name: open-sequence-read-fails
cases.covers: A failed catalog read inside the sequence is a trigger-failed diagnostic; the barrier still releases and a later report emits.

cases.name: no-actions-service
cases.covers: A document without the actions service reads as no catalog: the sequence has no steps.

diagnostics.message: document open sequence already fired for this document

cases.name: coordinator-diffs
cases.covers: Unplaced reports are ignored; a placed report emits close(old), invisible, visible, open(new); a report with no change emits nothing; a current page of null closes without opening.

cases.name: cascade-budget
cases.covers: Consecutive programmatic rounds past the cap are suppressed with a cascade-budget diagnostic (state still tracked); a user-caused report resets the count.

args.message: page-lifecycle emission suppressed: 9 consecutive programmatic rounds (cap 8)
page-lifecycle emission suppressed: 10 consecutive programmatic rounds (cap 8)

cases.name: cascade-budget-resets-on-user-activity
cases.covers: A user-origin dispatch resets the cascade count, and so does a user report while the barrier is closed.

cases.name: the-five-catalog-trees
cases.covers: Each verb-shaped document event resolves its Table-200 tree through dispatch; a missing tree is inert.

cases.name: missing-trees-are-inert
cases.covers: A catalog without the tree, or with a rootless one, is inert.

cases.name: open-runs-before-the-first-document-event
cases.covers: Under auto with the latch still armed, a first will-save runs the OpenAction inline first; the sequence then counts as fired.

diagnostics.message: document open sequence already fired for this document

args.message: document open sequence already fired for this document

cases.name: a-rejected-catalog-read-is-evicted
cases.covers: A rejected catalog read degrades to trigger-failed and is evicted, so the next event reads again.

cases.name: document-family-disabled
cases.covers: triggers.document false: runDocumentVerb skips both trees and still runs the operation; dispatch of a document event is trigger-disabled.

diagnostics.message: document: trigger family disabled by config
document: trigger family disabled by config

cases.name: prepare-close
cases.covers: prepareClose runs the will-close tree through the dispatch door.

cases.name: run-document-verb-serializes
cases.covers: Two concurrent save verbs never interleave: the second waits for the first operation and its did-save.

cases.name: run-document-verb-failure-laws
cases.covers: A failing will-save never cancels the operation; an operation that throws or rejects skips did-save and rethrows.

cases.name: run-document-verb-print-holds-the-latch
cases.covers: The print verb holds the print latch for its whole body: a Named Print inside will-print is suppressed as reentrant, and the latch is released after.

cases.name: print-verb-runs-wp-adapter-dp
cases.covers: A Named Print runs will-print, the adapter exactly once, then did-print; a Print nested in will-print is suppressed with reentrant-print.

args.message: print request during a document print event — suppressed (one dialog per request)

cases.name: an-adapter-throw-skips-did-print
cases.covers: An adapter print that throws rejects execute and skips did-print; the latch resets, so a later print works.

cases.name: adapter-uninstalled-mid-print
cases.covers: An adapter cleared while will-print runs leaves the print no-executor, without did-print.

cases.name: an-open-uri-throw-rejects-execute
cases.covers: An adapter openUri that throws rejects execute; the counter does not move.
